relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Extracellular HMGB1 binds to Toll‐like receptor 4 (TLR4), activating downstream inflammatory signaling pathways that promote the production of pro‐inflammatory cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor‐α (TNF‐α).

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: This interaction promotes the release of pro‐inflammatory cytokines such as TNF‐α, thereby amplifying neuroinflammation and exacerbating neuropathic pain [21].

key_findings: In CCI rats, IL-35 was reduced in serum and spinal cord while TNF-alpha, TLR4 and HMGB1 were increased at protein and mRNA level.
NP rats had fewer CD4+ and more CD8+ T cells; causality was not tested.
